Executive Construction Summary

VILLA CONGRE Nº3 · CARRER CONGRE Nº3

A high-spec contemporary villa on a steep Mediterranean residential hillside, requiring coordinated groundworks, retaining, structure, waterproofing, large glazing, specialist systems and premium finishes.

Risk, Control & Next Steps

Existing work status

Reconcile documentary status with physical site condition before remaining-scope pricing.

Rock / retaining

Confirm remaining groundworks, anchors, retaining sequence and access constraints.

Waterproofing interfaces

Inspect substrates, penetrations and drainage before covering.

Large-format glazing

Freeze openings, thresholds, waterproofing, drainage and finish interfaces before production.

Natural stone

Resolve selected stone, thickness, finish, fabrication details and interfaces early.

MEP coordination

Coordinate HVAC, UFH, KNX, lighting, ceilings and specialist systems before closures.

Client changes

Formal change request → technical review → quantity/cost/programme impact → approval.

Bespoke / specialist packages

Secure dimensions, models, pricing and installation access in the procurement plan.
